stem: A pharmacy wants to send expired controlled stock to another business for disposition. What status must it verify?

choices.text: Verify the recipient is appropriately DEA-registered as a reverse distributor and follow the transfer records.
Use the out-of-state prescription rule when its schedule, age, and verification conditions have not been checked.
Process another refill because an authorization written by the prescriber overrides schedule limits.
Treat the request as an insufficient-stock partial fill and use the 72-hour remainder rule.
Handle the drug or transaction as ordinary Massachusetts Schedule VI activity.

explanation.core_reasoning: A registrant may transfer controlled substances to a DEA-registered reverse distributor under the applicable inventory, ordering, transfer, and record requirements. The pharmacy must use the exact trigger and deadline rather than borrowing a nearby controlled-substance rule.

choice_analysis.A: This applies Transfer to a registered reverse distributor: A registrant may transfer controlled substances to a DEA-registered reverse distributor under the applicable inventory, ordering, transfer, and record requirements.
choice_analysis.B: That choice belongs, if at all, to Out-of-state Schedule III through VI prescriptions; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.C: That choice belongs, if at all, to Federal Schedule III and IV refill limits; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.D: That choice belongs, if at all, to Schedule II partial fill caused by pharmacy inability; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.E: That choice belongs, if at all, to Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription-drug status; its trigger does not match this scenario.

related_facts: A registrant may transfer controlled substances to a DEA-registered reverse distributor under the applicable inventory, ordering, transfer, and record requirements.
explanation.mpje_trap: Applying out-of-state iii-vi to facts controlled by reverse distribution.

reasoning_steps: Identify the trigger for Transfer to a registered reverse distributor
